settings.text:
Every piece carries a one-year limited warranty against manufacturing faults. It covers workmanship — a setting that fails, a clasp that was never right. It does not cover accidents, ordinary wear, loss, or damage from repairs done elsewhere.

To make a claim, use the Warranty Claim form and include clear photographs of the problem. We may ask you to send the piece in so we can look at it properly; if we do, inbound shipping is arranged and paid by you, and must be tracked and insured.

Once we have inspected it we will tell you what we are going to do about it. The terms you agreed to are below.

settings.heading: Your CaratForUs warranty
settings.subheading: One year against manufacturing faults, handled by the company that sold you the piece.
